_provenance: Authored for Mentor: one habit sentence per skill, used in grounded packages and templates (docs/backend/07 §3.2). Own wording; needs owner review.

habits.piece_safety: Before you move, ask which of your pieces nothing protects, and which enemy piece could take on the new square.
habits.opponent_threats: After every move they make, ask what it attacks now and what it will attack next.
habits.checks_captures_threats: List every check, capture and threat, theirs first, before you choose.
habits.tactic_fork: Look for one move that attacks two valuable things at once, and watch for the same against you.
habits.tactic_pin: Notice which of your pieces are lined up with something more valuable behind them.
habits.tactic_skewer: Notice when a valuable piece stands in front of another piece on the same line.
habits.tactic_discovered: When one of your pieces moves, ask what line it uncovers for them or for you.
habits.tactic_backrank: Give your king an escape square so a rook or queen cannot trap it on the back rank.
habits.tactic_removing_defender: Ask which piece guards the target, and whether it can be taken or chased away.
habits.mate_patterns: Count the king's escape squares before you decide there is no mate.
habits.material_counting: Count what you win and what you lose before you trade or capture.
habits.blunder_check: After you choose a move, scan where their pieces can land before you play it.
habits.default: Before you move, check what their last move did and what your move leaves unprotected.
